description.name: Notificações via WhatsApp API
description.tagline: Dispara mensagens para a plataforma WHMCS quando hooks são executados.
description.long: Possibilita o disparo manual e automático de mensagens através da API do WhatsApp.
features: Client Notification: Login, Registration, Change password
Invoice Notification: Create, Paid, Reminder(First, Second, Third Overdue)
Service Notification: Create, Suspend, Unsuspend, Change package, Change passwordr
Domain Notification: Registration, Transfer, Renewal, Reminder(First, Second, Third Overdue)
Ticket Notification: Admin reply, Close, Open admin, User reply
